summary: Stores the channel count 3 into dword_8B8E48, then initializes a fixed run of 35 (dword_8B8E48 + 32) audio channel objects in the array beginning at dword_8B6C28, calling sub_556260 on each element with the literal argument 1 and advancing 76 bytes per element. Returns the final count dword_8B8E48 + 32 (35).

local_names.v0: element counter for the channel array loop
local_names.v1: pointer to the current channel object, advanced 76 bytes per iteration

operations.description: Write the channel count 3 into global dword_8B8E48.
Initialize the loop counter v0 to 0 and base the element pointer v1 at the start of the channel array dword_8B6C28.
do-while loop that runs while v0 < dword_8B8E48 + 32, i.e. 35 iterations.
Call sub_556260 on the current channel element with the literal argument 1; the element is treated as a 76-byte object.
Increment v0 and advance the element pointer v1 by 76 bytes to the next channel object.

unresolved: The identity and role of the 76-byte channel object and of sub_556260's second argument (1) are not documented in this packet.
Relationship between the stored count 3 and the fixed loop bound 32 (i.e. why 35 objects) is unresolved.
